content.short: KAZM leverages Web3 memberships to foster community building and loyalty programs.
content.description: KAZM helps brands keep members engaged and rewarded across channels by delivering no-code Web3 membership benefits that sidestep NFT complexities. It integrates smoothly with existing touchpoints like social channels and Stripe, letting organizations create exclusive member spaces, offer targeted discounts, and run gamified experiences. The platform also surfaces deep audience insights, enabling smarter campaigns without migrations or wallets, so participation stays seamless for members and deployment remains straightforward for teams.

resources.title: Forecasting Geopolitical Risk With Foresight Learning
resources.tldr: A small open model trained only on public news beats GPT-5 at predicting military strikes. The result matters less than the method, which is reproducible.

resources.title: AI Reaches Human Superforecaster Range
resources.tldr: On ForecastBench the best systems now sit statistically level with the median human superforecaster. Benchmark caveats stated rather than buried.

resources.title: Predicting Patient Outcomes From Clinical Notes
resources.tldr: A small model trained on existing hospital notes, with no manual labelling, predicting ventilation and dialysis.
